$comment: GENERATED by .github/scripts/core-build-stages.py --write from CI_SHARD_TOTAL in .github/workflows/dotnet-test.yml; --check reds any drift. One declaration for both routes: a candidate DEPLOYMENT runs test-shard-<i> and doc-gate as pinned runs from the set's mw-core-tests image (/core-tests); a host PR/trunk run builds first and packs its own tree. Every shard reads the pack built from the run's own commit (--require-sha), never another set's. `owes` is what the stages still check less than dotnet-test.yml; ciEquivalent is refused while it is non-empty (check-build-stages.py, profile core).
owes: route: dotnet-test.yml has no admission — no job calls build-executor.py and no follow job (build-follow.yml) stands in for the `build`, `test` and `doc-gate` jobs, so even an equivalent declaration would route nothing (the satellites' shape: node-repo-build-executor.yml + build-follow.yml + a host-verdict input)

Consolidate test results: collect-results consolidates the testResults-shard<i> trx artifacts of the `test` matrix; a host shard hands no trx back (nothing is written under $MW_BUILD_ARTIFACTS), so the consolidated verdict, the failure summary and the per-project MISSING_BIN evidence cannot be built from a host run

fan-out: a host runs one run's stages serially — build 25 + 8 shards x 20 + doc-gate 25 minutes is past the run deadline; the deployment route already submits one pinned run per stage, but such runs do not share one $MW_BUILD_OUTPUTS, so the shards need this run's pack through the shared cache (`needs: outputs`), which today promotes only a trunk run's content-keyed output (Actions: one `build`, then the 8-way `test` matrix)

prepared packages: the build restores ONLY from the host's prepared cache (NUGET_FALLBACK_PACKAGES); that the cache holds core's whole restore closure, refreshed when Directory.Packages.props changes, is not established (Actions: the `build` job's NuGet-shelf hydration and restore)

browser: the shards that run browser tests need the headless browser and the font set the `browser-fonts` job stages and each `test` shard provisions; the build-host image (MeshWeaver.Deploy deploy/build-host/Dockerfile) carries neither

containers: the shards' Testcontainers projects start a database in Docker; a host's sandbox has no Docker daemon (its database is sandbox-postgres.sh), so those projects cannot run there as they run in the `test` job
shard post-gates: the `test` job runs check-untyped-content.sh (no content degraded to an untyped JsonElement) over each shard's logs; core-tests.py run does not
dependent legs: platform-compat and licence-gate read the `build` job's artifacts (shard 0's output, the licence evidence); with the build on a host they need its outputs handed back

prepared mesh: on a host no test may install a mesh from scratch — a prepared mesh snapshot is cloned per run; which of core's fixtures that replaces is not established (owned by the prepared-server work)
evidence: no stage has run on a host — a probe of every stage on build-latest must be green and agree with the Actions legs of the same commit

stages.name: build
stages.command: set -euo pipefail; : "${NUGET_FALLBACK_PACKAGES:?the host bound no prepared package cache (needs: nuget)}"; dotnet build MeshWeaver.slnx -c Release -p:CIRun=true -warnaserror --source "${NUGET_FALLBACK_PACKAGES}"; missing=$(comm -23 <(find test -name '*.csproj' ! -path '*/bin/*' | sort) <(grep -oE 'test/[^"]+\.csproj' MeshWeaver.slnx | sort)); if [ -n "$missing" ]; then echo "::error::these test projects are not in MeshWeaver.slnx, so they are never built and their tests never run: $missing"; exit 1; fi; python3 deploy/core-tests/core-tests.py pack --repo . --out "${MW_BUILD_OUTPUTS:?the host names no run outputs (MW_BUILD_OUTPUTS)}/core-tests" --sha "${MW_BUILD_SHA:?the host names no commit (MW_BUILD_SHA)}" --version "run-${MW_BUILD_SHA}"

stages.name: test-shard-0
